request.answer: After the Initial Term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Provider may increase the fees for any renewal term by up to 3% over the fees for the preceding term by giving notice at least ninety (90) days before the renewal date. If Provider fails to meet this commitment in a calendar month, Customer will recieve a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee for each full hour of unavailability, up to a minimum of 10% of the monthly fee for that month. For ninety (90) days after termination or expiration, Provider will make Customer Data available for export, after which Provider will delete it.

request.instructions: The source is one version of an agreement. Each claim is a sentence taken from the other version of the same agreement. A claim is supported when the source states the same obligation, right, amount, rate, period, party and place, even if the wording, spelling, punctuation or number formatting differs. A claim is contradicted when the source states something different about any of those. Judge each claim against the passage of the source that covers the same subject.
